tool_args.rationale: The archived two-layer siphon with a signed square-root correction fits all five paid observations to rounding precision (pilot RMSE about 2.7e-8). The numerical fit gives vmax about 8.522, rho about 0.709, and a square-root coefficient of about -0.344. Submit this model for fresh confirmation without buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Base siphon alone or with linear bleed
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Pilot RMSEs are 0.0268 and 0.0129, respectively. The square-root branch fits to rounding precision with no more parameters than linear bleed.
The five pilot rows already distinguish the negative square-root branch from linear bleed across s_grad values from 0.25 to 2.20.
The static siphon model explains the pilot at the target horizon to rounding precision, so a trajectory batch is not needed to select the model.
